sessions.description: Session introduction voiceovers explaining each session

clips.text: Welcome to Hale Base. This foundational practice will help you regulate stress and build breath capacity. We'll use rhythmic nose breathing to find balance. Settle in, and let's begin.
Welcome to Hale Elixir. This is a high-intensity activation practice. We'll use powerful mouth breathing to energize your body and clear your mind. Get ready to push your limits.
Welcome to Hale Rest. This soothing practice uses extended exhales to activate deep relaxation and prepare you for restful sleep. Let your body sink into comfort.
Welcome to Hale Flow. This balanced box breathing practice creates equilibrium and cultivates rhythmic awareness. Find your center, and let the breath guide you.
Welcome to Hale First Breath... A few quiet minutes, with nothing to get right... Just follow my voice, and the light.
Welcome to Hale Tide... We'll breathe like the sea, slow and even... and then let the out-breath grow a little longer.
Welcome to Hale Roots... A few minutes to feel grounded... We'll rest briefly at the top of each breath, and let a long breath out.
Welcome to Hale Unwind... We'll let each out-breath grow a little longer... There is nothing to hold, and nothing to get right.
Welcome to Hale Sunrise... A light, lively rhythm to wake you gently... Breathe through your nose, and never force it.

Rest in the stillness... No effort required.
A gentle breath in... hold softly... and release.
Each exhale softens your muscles... Each pause deepens your calm.

One calming breath... embrace the stillness.
Breath becomes effortless... Body becomes light... Mind becomes still.

Final breath... complete peace... you are ready.
Natural breath now... Allow yourself to drift... Sweet dreams await.
Notice your heartbeat... Let it guide you to presence.
Inhale 4... Hold 4... Exhale 4... Hold 4... Find your rhythm.
Let the rhythm continue in your body... Natural, effortless.
One deep breath... Feel the balance.
Longer counts now... Inhale 5... Hold 5... Exhale 5... Hold 5.
You are the breath... The breath is you... Unity.
One cleansing breath... Fully present.

sessions.description: Hale First Breath - the four-minute beginner session through the four starter worlds (screen-synced: matches subPrompt)

clips.text: Sit comfortably... let your shoulders drop... and breathe in and out through your nose.
In for five... out for five... smooth and quiet, like a slow wave.
Now a gentle square... in for four... a soft pause... out for four... a soft pause. If a pause feels long, keep it short.
Let the breath go back to its own pace... and notice how you feel.

sessions.description: Hale Tide - beginner session, opened by chapter 1 with Ocean Tide (screen-synced: matches subPrompt)

clips.text: Listen to the tide... breathe in as it comes in... and out as it goes.
In through the nose... out through the nose... even, like waves on the shore.
Now keep the same easy rhythm on your own... let the waves count for you.
Let each out-breath run a little longer... like water drawing back from the sand.
Let the breath come and go on its own... like the tide.

sessions.description: Hale Roots - beginner session, opened by chapter 2 with Ancient Forest (screen-synced: matches subPrompt)

clips.text: Feel where your body meets the ground... and let it hold you.
Breathe in... rest for a moment at the top... then one long breath out.
Keep breathing this way on your own... and let your weight sink a little more each time.
A slightly longer rest at the top now... and let the out-breath roll down into the ground.
Breathe naturally... feel steady... and supported.

sessions.description: Hale Unwind - beginner session, opened by chapter 3 with Aurora Dreams (screen-synced: matches subPrompt)

clips.text: Let your jaw soften... let your hands rest... nothing needs doing now.
Breathe in gently... and let a longer breath out... like a quiet sigh.
Longer still... let the out-breath carry the day away.
Let the breath slow down on its own... and rest here.

clips.text: Sit tall... let your shoulders open... and let the light find you.
A little quicker now... still through the nose... light and easy.
Quicker still... light, not deep... If you feel light-headed, just breathe normally.
Breathe however feels good... notice the warmth... and how awake you feel.

Round two... go deeper.
Final round... give everything.

Recovery breath.
Integration... let go completely.
Prepare for the next round.
Breathe in... whenever you're ready.
Let the breath deepen a little... move your fingers and toes... and open your eyes when you're ready.
You're doing beautifully... keep going.
You're halfway there... stay with it.
Almost there... one more round.
Thank yourself for this practice... for showing up.
Be proud of yourself... you showed up today.
